preview.what: The service container: bindings, singletons, contextual binding, auto-wiring.
preview.picture: A hotel concierge: you ask for 'a payment gateway' and it hands you the right one, already set up, without you knowing which company it called.
preview.why: 'How does Laravel know what to inject?' is the classic Laravel senior opener.
preview.bn: Hotel-এর concierge: 'একটা payment gateway দাও' বললে ঠিকটা সাজিয়ে দেয়, তুমি জানো না কাকে ডাকল।
